# Sound Reconstruction

## Original Paper

Park, J.-Y., Tsukamoto, M., Tanaka, M., & Kamitani, Y. (2025). Natural sounds can be reconstructed from human neuroimaging data using deep neural network representation. PLOS Biology, 23(7), e3003293. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003293

## Dataset

This dataset contains fMRI scans acquired while participants listened to various sound stimuli, designed for training and testing sound reconstruction models.

The following three types of data are included for five subjects:
- SoundTraining
- SoundTest
- SoundAttention

## Code

See: [https://github.com/KamitaniLab/SoundReconstruction](https://github.com/KamitaniLab/SoundReconstruction).
